bundle.shortDescription: Cross-platform desktop file explorer built with Tauri v2 and Svelte 5.
bundle.longDescription: A high-performance, cross-platform native file explorer for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Features multi-tab navigation, split-pane views, indexed search, session restoration, and a polished glassmorphic dark/light UI.
